∀ {n T : Nat},
  LT.lt.{0} 0 T →
    ∀ (u : Real),
      LE.le.{0} 0 u →
        ∀ (x y : Fin n → Real) (e : Research.BlockDotProduct.RoundingTrace),
          Research.BlockDotProduct.RoundingTrace.Admissible e n T u →
            LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} T (Research.BlockDotProduct.treeDepth n T))) u) 1 →
              LT.lt.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑(Research.BlockDotProduct.errorIndex n T)) u) 1 →
                ∃ Δx Δy,
                  And
                    (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockDotProduct.computedDot T x y e)
                      (∑ i, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (x i) (Δx i)) (y i)))
                    (And
                      (∀ (i : Fin n),
                        LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (Δx i))
                          (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                            (Research.BlockDotProduct.gamma (Research.BlockDotProduct.errorIndex n T) u)
                            (abs.{0} (x i))))
                      (And
                        (Eq.{1} (Research.BlockDotProduct.computedDot T x y e)
                          (∑ i, HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (x i) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (y i) (Δy i))))
                        (∀ (i : Fin n),
                          LE.le.{0} (abs.{0} (Δy i))
                            (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0}
                              (Research.BlockDotProduct.gamma (Research.BlockDotProduct.errorIndex n T) u)
                              (abs.{0} (y i))))))
